newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Re confident of forecast - paper.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Re confident of forecast - paper.

text.p: Walter Kielholz, new chief executive of Swiss Reinsurance Co, said the company's profit forecast from December was still valid and it was very likely that the company would report a 1996 profit increase of over 20 percent.
In an interview with Swiss daily Basler Zeitung, Kielholz also said recent changes in exchange rates could alter the volume of Swiss Re's business volume in Anglo-Saxon countries.
"But we will very likely achieve a profit improvement of considerably over 20 percent, which we indicated then," Kielholz told the newspaper.
